Executive New Four Bedroom A-Rated Detached Residence 

Kinsella Estates Carnew & Gorey are truly delighted to offer this exciting new private 
4-bedroom detached home at 10 Coolattin View, Coolroe, Coolboy, Co. Wicklow, which will be built to a very high standard of specification. This family home which will be built of block construction with an A energy rating, will ensure this stylish home will be exceptionally energy efficient with low running costs with the benefit of air to water heating and triple-glazed windows. 

The property which is currently under construction will be completed by December 2026

10 Coolattin View, Coolroe is located within walking distance of Coolboy, 6.2 Km’s Tinahely, 6.6 Km’s Shillelagh and just 7.2 km’s Carnew many amenities such as supermarkets, pharmacy, restaurants, day care, primary schools nearby.

The auctioneer recommends an early viewing of same. 

Please note that these images are computer-generated and are provided for illustrative purposes only. They are intended to give a general impression of the proposed property and should not be relied upon as an exact representation of the finished property. Specifications, finishes, layouts, and dimensions may be subject to change.
